lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地在灰上走。
lines.en: I hop along the ash in short bounds.

lines.zh: 我的腿一落地就扬起灰。
lines.en: Ash puffs up wherever my legs land.
I keep low and spring forward.
A thin haze lies over the ash.
I travel along the edge of the waste.
My hops are crooked, but fast.
I come out from behind an ash heap.
I listen as I hop.
I go forward in fits and starts.
I close in your direction.
I crouch with ash collecting on my back.
I listen in the ash.
Nothing here is clear to see.
I lift my head; there is light in the haze.
My ear is pressed to the ground, listening.
I stay still, like a lump of scorched earth.
The ash here is dry and pale.
I stretch my legs slowly.
The haze flows past along the ground.
You are standing on my ash.
I pressed my belly to the ash.

lines.zh: 你身上的味儿我没闻过。
lines.en: I have never smelled your kind before.
My hind legs are set.

lines.zh: 我的前脚往前搭了一搭。
lines.en: My front feet shuffled forward.

lines.zh: 我在等你跨过我的灰堆。
lines.en: I wait for you to step over my pile of ash.
When you move, the ash rises.
There is a sound in my throat.
One hop and I am clear.
I roll once in the ash.

lines.zh: 腿有点僵，灰尘落进去了。
lines.en: Legs a bit stiff. Ash got in them.
I tuck my hind legs and crouch.
I pushed up on all four legs.
Ash sticks to the wound.
I cried out shrilly.
I pulled back into the deep ash haze.
I am still down in the ash.
Is that food?
I hop toward your hand.
There is a smell, but not the right one.
I snatch it away at once.
Ash has fallen into it.
I bit down and got a mouthful of ash.
This is dry enough to crack teeth.
I am hoping for a second bite.
Do not be in a rush to pull your hand back.
You hit me and I spring back a length.
I bounced off and hopped back.
I land at your feet.
That does not really hurt.
I shake the ash off my back.
I retreat behind an ash heap.
I drop low again.
Watch me when you set your feet down.
I slid on the ash.
All four legs are set again.
In this season I do nothing else.
We press close in the ash.
I hop in a circle around it.
Afterwards I go back to my hollow.
The haze covers us both.
I am alone on this ash plain.
I hopped off behind an ash heap.
The season is very short.

lines.zh: 各走各的，灰里不留脚印。
lines.en: We go our ways; no prints in the ash.
I snapped it up in one bite.
Not edible; I drop it back in the ash.
I pin it with a leg.

lines.zh: 灰堆里，我埋过的东西都找得到。
lines.en: I can find anything I buried in ash.
I take it and hop away.
This crumbles at a touch.
I leaned in and gave it a sniff.
I push it along as I go.
I am not chewing that.
I froze in the ash at once.
You have stepped into my ash.
I loaded my hind legs.
I am ready to spring.
In the haze I hear everything.

lines.zh: 灰堆里，我的肉叫灰跃肉。
lines.en: In the ash heap, my meat is Ash Hopper Meat.
This ash plain is mine.
I kicked off the ground and shot out.
I make for your ankle.
Backing off will not save you.
I flatten onto the ash.
I am coming at you.
My teeth show.
My slide over the ash is soft.
I kicked off and shot out.
I follow you in hops.
You turn left and I cut across.
I stay in the ash haze.
I am not fast, but I cover ground.
Every landing leaves a pit.

lines.zh: 你听不见我，灰会吃掉声音。
lines.en: You cannot hear me; the ash eats sound.
I stay close.
Just a little nearer.
I drive you toward the ash heaps.
Your steps have moved backward.
I have hopped nearer.
The ash haze is thickening.
I have fixed on the spot where you stand.
I pause, then hop.
This hop will be long.
You will not get off this ash plain.
The last leap.
I skim along the ash surface.
I have picked a new landing spot.
I spring at your leg.
I bite your ankle.
I rake with a foreleg.
That leap landed true.
We have raised a cloud of ash.
I kicked off and leapt again.
My hind legs kick up a cloud of ash.
You fall back; I am still in the ash.
My teeth are coated in ash.
I brushed up against its leg.
Your feet are not steady.
I leap once more.
This leap is for you.

lines.zh: 我从灰里弹起来咬你的膝。
lines.en: I burst out of the ash and bite your knee.

lines.zh: 我后腿一蹬，撞在你胸口。
lines.en: I kick off and hit your chest.
I hop circles around your legs.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，灰也一起咬进来了。
lines.en: I bite down, ash and all.

lines.zh: 灰堆动了一下，我出来了。
lines.en: The ash heap shifts, and I come out.
I spring out of the haze.
A line of shallow pits appears.
I land on the ash with very little sound.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把鼻子伸进风里。
lines.en: I raised my head and put my nose into the wind.
There is another smell in the ash.
I flatten and look ahead.
The haze rises off the ground.
I settled onto the ash and held still.

lines.zh: 火燎到我，我在灰里打滚。
lines.en: Fire catches me and I roll in the ash.
My leg buckles on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我拼命往外爬。
lines.en: Water fills my throat; I claw my way out.
The blast throws me over the ash heaps.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我后腿的关节。
lines.en: Something lodged in my hind-leg joint.

lines.zh: 一股力定住我，我挣不开。
lines.en: Some force pins me and I cannot break free.
Hunger leaves me unable to leap.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只都缩了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I clamp up.
There is no ash and nothing to grip.
